description.purpose: The own store of `./followup` (D58 followup, GH #1479): one row `open:<day>:<round tag>` per person and day -- the concern's note id, claim, receipt, text, `until`, the session that heard it and its channel node, and its state (`held` while that session runs -- out at the surface that did not hear it, held for the hearing surface and `./cogny` --, `open` once the note is out everywhere, `closed` once asked after). The unique index on `followup.key` makes the first write an insert-if-absent and every later one a compare-and-set on the value read; every write deletes the rows of past days. Only `./followup` speaks to it.
